# Safe Harbours

> Safe Harbours (Safe Harbours Family Treatment Homes) is an Ontario treatment foster care agency based in Hamilton. We recruit, train, and support foster parents — with on-call support, a dedicated case management team, and a staff-supported model (Child and Youth Workers and a child psychologist) for children with complex needs.

Contact: phone 647-493-9207 · email info@safeharbours.ca · 517 Upper Sherman Ave., 1st Floor, Hamilton, Ontario, L8V 3L7. Serving Ontario, Canada.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.safeharbours.ca/): Become a foster parent in Ontario — training, on-call support, and case management.
- [About Fostering](https://www.safeharbours.ca/about-fostering): What foster care is, trauma-informed care, and common questions.
- [Become a Foster Parent](https://www.safeharbours.ca/become-a-foster-parent): The application process, requirements, and how Safe Harbours supports caregivers.
- [Our Story](https://www.safeharbours.ca/our-story): The agency's founding, purpose, values, and team.
- [Careers](https://www.safeharbours.ca/careers): Working at Safe Harbours and current opportunities.
- [Program Description](https://www.safeharbours.ca/program-description): The treatment foster care program model, services, and staffing.
- [Complaints](https://www.safeharbours.ca/program-description/complaints): The complaints policy and process.
- [Resources](https://www.safeharbours.ca/resources): Guides and articles on fostering in Ontario.
- [Contact Us](https://www.safeharbours.ca/contact-us): Phone, email, address, and a contact form.
